channel.title: AI & Healthcare AI Daily
channel.description: A daily briefing on AI and healthcare AI, summarized by Claude.

item.title: Anthropic sets $1.4T IPO range; Google launches Gemini for healthcare
item.description:
• Anthropic's IPO pricing and OpenAI's $10B quarter show how big AI's money has become, and how much it is spending.
  • Google shipped on several fronts: Gemini 4 Carbon, AlphaGenome 2, AI-checked Signal code and Gemini for healthcare.
  • Healthcare AI is consolidating and adding safety checks: Oura buys Counsel for $625M and MDCalc launches a safety layer for clinical AI.
